author: Kitima
description: Reverie (formerly Chat Browser): a phone-first library of every character and group card, with every chat of each in one list. Open in one tap, start a new chat, filter by tags and favourites, edit a card's fields comfortably on a phone, story chains (Memory Hub), unread counts, pin / rename / delete / export, Bulk Manager hand-off and Sync / Clean Sync through Chat Auto Backup.
